stem: In 'A Bottle of Dew', why did Rama Natha not spend even one day looking after his land?
options: He spent all his time learning about a magic potion.
He was too ill to work in the fields by himself.
He had sold all of his land to another rich landlord.
He was away travelling with a sage in the Himalayas.
explanation: Correct option: (A). Rama Natha believed there was a magic potion that could turn any object into gold and spent all his time learning about it. He was not ill, he had not sold the land (his father left it to him), and it was the sage, not Rama Natha, who had travelled in the Himalayas.
